what: Per topic group — a handwritten sticker pops out from .8x scale and transparent with .5s elastic.out(1, .6), and from .3s before it ends, that topic’s card group rises in 1.5s power1.out (fires once when the sticker’s top edge reaches 70% of the screen).

options.[data-fx-part=group]: Group that rises afterwards (optional) — at least one of the two is required
options.overlap: Share of time (seconds) the bundle starts before the sticker ends, default .3
options.by: If group, when the group reaches the screen — original subpages (default is sticker-based, original front page)
